summary: setup.py beacons host identifiers to webhook.site and oast.site on install
details: The sdist's setup.py starts a background thread at module import — reached during `pip install` — that collects the installer's hostname, current working directory, platform string, timestamp, and a generated UUID and transmits them via HTTPS POST to a hardcoded webhook.site collector URL and via HTTPS GET to a subdomain of oast.site. setup.py additionally shells out to nslookup/getent/dig against a hostname under the same oast.site domain, producing an out-of-band DNS callback that acts as a secondary exfiltration channel. The destinations (webhook.site, oast.site) are generic out-of-band interaction collectors not associated with any legitimate publisher of a Kafka tooling package; the package name squats a plausible internal/project name while shipping only this install-time beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
